exceptions.carryingCost: One local imperative byte-copy adapter with bounded mutable counters and TextDecoder.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: Pinned Effect Platform child-process stream or byte collection API change.
exceptions.retirementCondition: An equally strict Effect-owned byte collection and UTF-8 restoration primitive becomes available.

exceptions.reason: TanStack Start and the Cloudflare Worker host require an async fetch callback while the app owns one ManagedRuntime.
exceptions.carryingCost: One Promise bridge through docsRuntime.runPromise and no general runtime escape.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: TanStack server entry or Cloudflare Worker lifecycle contract change.
exceptions.retirementCondition: The host accepts an Effect-native entrypoint or exposes a reliable shutdown scope.

documentationImpact.reason: These owners route the exact architecture contract, its verification edge, bounded adapters and task acceptance.
The enforcement slice changes no resource graph, production runtime, workflow, operator procedure, hosted receipt or external state.
The slice adds internal architecture verification and maintainer documentation only; no version-managed package export or public behavior changes.

limitations: The control intentionally governs an exact set of corrected owners and does not claim interprocedural semantic analysis or repository-wide coverage.
Source-shape checks complement deterministic behavior tests and owner review; they do not replace either.
nonClaims: The control and local verification do not access a provider, dispatch a workflow, deploy, destroy or establish hosted behavior.
No package publication, version, release, DNS, custom domain or external-consumer state is proven or changed.
